tools.name: create-task-note
tools.title: Create Task Note
tools.description: Create a TaskNotes Markdown task in the user's Obsidian vault. Use this when the user asks to add, capture, schedule, or create a task.

ai.instructions: TaskNotes stores tasks as Markdown files with YAML frontmatter in the user's Obsidian vault. Create tasks only when the user asks to add, capture, schedule, or create a task. Preserve concise task titles, map hashtags to tags, map @mentions to contexts, map project references to projects, and use ISO 8601 dates when calling tools.
